G.SKILL Announces Revolutionary RGB Lighting DDR4 with Trident Z RGB Series - Unadulterated RGB Illumination - G.SKILL International Enterprise Co., Ltd.

# G.SKILL Announces Revolutionary RGB Lighting DDR4 with Trident Z RGB Series - Unadulterated RGB Illumination

 (20 December 2016) – G.SKILL International Enterprise Co., Ltd., the world's leading manufacturer of extreme performance memory and gaming peripherals, is thrilled to announce the Trident Z RGB Series - the world's most revolutionary RGB lighting DDR4 memory kit. Requiring no additional power connections, this incredible feat of engineering bares pure RGB lighting across an uncovered full-length light bar on the award-winning Trident Z series heatspreader design. To take a look at what's to come, check out the following link for the Trident Z RGB trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fPx0LNzgQm4

Full Range RGB Illumination; Software Control

By default, the Trident Z RGB will display a rainbow of colors in a wave-style lighting effect, illuminating any system with a myriad of hues. Further lighting effects and color customizations can be controlled and chosen through software, scheduled for a February 2017 release.

Uncompromised Performance

A culmination of over 25 years of experience in DRAM manufacturing, G.SKILL sought to combine full-range RGB lighting with minimal impact on DDR4 performance. Designed with a custom 10-layer PCB and hand-picked IC chips to enhance overclocking performance, the Trident Z RGB series is capable of reaching speeds of DDR4-4266MHz.

Trident Z RGB series memory kits are rigorously tested under proprietary G.SKILL test methods for reliability and compatibility to ensure the highest possible quality. And like all other G.SKILL memory, the Trident Z RGB is covered under a limited lifetime warranty, as well as full support for XMP 2.0 for easy overclocking and simple BIOS setup.

Availability

Trident Z RGB series DDR4 memory kits are scheduled for a worldwide release via G.SKILL authorized distribution partners in mid-January 2017, with software to be available for download the following month.

Title: G.Skill Lights Up Trident Z Memory Kits With RGB LEDs (Updated) | Tom's Hardware
URL: https://www.tomshardware.com/news/gskill-trident-z-rgb-memory,33224.html
Published: 2016-12-29T21:36:00.000Z
Author: Derek Forrest
Highlights:
# G.Skill Lights Up Trident Z Memory Kits With RGB LEDs (Updated)

 By Derek Forrest 

 Published 29 December 2016 

Update, 12/29/16, 1:36pm PT: G.Skill said the new Trident Z RGB kits will be priced slightly above the company's current Trident Z products.

G.Skill announced a new Trident Z-branded memory kit with RGB LED lights.

The Trident Z RGB series features an uncovered full-length light bar on the heatsink of each module. They are set to display a rainbow of colors with a wave-style effect by default, and there isn’t much you can do to adjust the lighting until G.Skill releases the accompanying software a month after these kits become available.

The full specifications and SKU list for the new Trident Z RGB series aren't available yet, but the company claimed that the new memory is capable of reaching speeds of 4,266MHz with its 10-layer PCB and handpicked IC chips. This, of course, does little to give us an idea of what kind of performance and capacities we can expect from the new memory, and it appears we’ll have to wait to see the bright side of these new RGB LED kits.

---

Published: 2016-12-20T14:46:51.000Z
Author: Federico Bertoli
Highlights:
# G.Skill Trident Z RGB, memorie DDR4 che illuminano i PC 

 G.Skill si appresta a portare sul mercato nuove memorie DDR4 della linea Trident Z in versione RGB. 

 a cura di Federico Bertoli 

 Pubblicato il 20/12/2016 alle 15:46 

Anche G.Skill, noto produttore di RAM ad alte prestazioni, ha deciso di portare sul mercato moduli dotati di illuminazione a LED RGB.

Per farlo ha scelto il suo modello di punta, la serie Trident Z, ovvero memorie DDR4 ad alte frequenze che trovano posto in molti PC per appassionati.

Il sistema di illuminazione non richiede alcuna connessione aggiuntiva ed è costituito da LED incorporati in una barra che corre nella parte centrale del caratteristico heatspreader nero realizzato in alluminio spazzolato.

L'impostazione predefinita compone un effetto arcobaleno in cui ogni modulo mostra più sfumature di colore, ma sarà possibile impostare la propria combinazione di colori, sfumature ed effetti grazie al software che sarà distribuito dopo il lancio.

Sotto l'heatspreader e la barra luminosa non ci sono sorprese: G.Skill ha confermato l'uso di PCB a 10 strati e chip selezionati per garantire le ottime performance in overclock a cui siamo abituati.

G.Skill ha dichiarato solamente che saranno disponibili kit garantiti a vita e certificati per frequenze fino a 4266 MHz con supporto a XMP 2.0. Tuttavia, basandoci sull'attuale linea Trident Z, ci aspettiamo kit dual channel da 8/16/32 GB e quad channel da 16/32/64/128 GB con frequenze da 2800 MHz in poi.

...

Non si sa nulla del prezzo delle Trident Z RGB ma la disponibilità è prevista per gennaio, mentre il software di gestione sarà pubblicato a febbraio.
